name: iStreet Network Limited
summary: iStreet Network Limited functions as a multi-channel retail company, engaging in both internet-based and catalog sales. Its core business involves the promotion and distribution of a diverse array of branded products. These goods are offered for sale to customers through its dedicated retail outlet, iStreet Bazaar, as well as its various online platforms. The firm was established on June 26, 1986, by co-founders Pradeep Malu and Lakshya Malu, and maintains its principal office in Mumbai, India.
